title: The Primal Diet
author: Aajonus Vonderplanitz
description: The Primal Diet: We Want to Live (expanded and revised 2005) by Aajonus Vonderplanitz (1947-2013), the American nutritionist and founder of the raw-animal-food Primal Diet movement. Part autobiography and part manual, it tells the author's account of recovering from a series of grave illnesses through eating raw foods, then sets out his dietary system: raw meat, fish, eggs, unpasteurised dairy and animal fats, raw vegetable juices and specific 'formulas', with detox and healing protocols and his theories that cooked food and processed products cause disease. The book's claims are highly controversial and conflict with mainstream medical and food-safety advice. It belongs in the library's Health section as the source text of a radical alternative-health philosophy.
